name: Discretized Gaussian Representation (DGR)
definition: A framework that reconstructs the 3D volume directly using a set of discretized Gaussian functions in an end-to-end manner, addressing the integration bias and density inconsistency inherent in standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) when applied to CT.
summary: Discretized Gaussian Representation is a 3D tomographic reconstruction framework that models volumes as discretized Gaussian sums, using a differentiable alignment mechanism to avoid the integration bias and non-differentiability of standard Gaussian Splatting.
